mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which can stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following UNRATE increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods following HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and housing starts indicates strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 60-day periods following simultaneous increases in RSAFS and HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods following INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate indicates tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate combined with low federal funds rate indicates a weak economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 30% of the 60-day periods following high UNRATE and low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods following GDPC1 growth slowdowns.
